name: quiz-prep-cards
does: A card at the top of Topics for each quiz in course.js `quizzes` ({id, name, when, minutes, topics or modules, covers, quote, said, src}) until the quiz is over or the student hides it: the day and time, the days left, what it covers, the professor's words and what the professor said to prepare, and drills over the quiz's questions (concepts, calculations, everything, adaptive; a straight pass). Settings puts a hidden card back. It does not change the exam the page prepares for and has no timed practice quiz.
